svg.title: free-cup-holder.exe setup
svg.desc: A DOS prompt runs free-cup-holder.exe: it finds the CD-ROM drive, ejects the tray, fills a progress bar, and a coffee mug lands on the open tray of a beige pixel-art PC. Cup holder installed successfully. Warning: do not press EJECT. Then the console goes idle and the Flying Mugs screensaver starts: winged pixel mugs and stray CDs fly across a starfield.
svg.text: free-cup-holder.exe - Flying Mugs (press any key, except EJECT)
